title: Mariner Merchant POC — Infosec Evidence Logbook
content:
Purpose:
This logbook collates the security and compliance artifacts we produced for the Mariner Merchant POC (holiday-payments use case). It is an operational snapshot intended for the customer's infosec review and for internal audit traceability. Not a final packet — living doc while evidence is gathered.

Scope / boundaries:
- Systems included: Redwood Hosted API (eu-west region), Dedicated pool (demo-reserved), and sample Private VPC deployment (test-vpc-01).
- Data types: payment metadata (PII-lite: email, last4 card masked), logs, trace spans. No full card PANs stored in any Redwood staging environment.
- Controls evaluated: authentication/authorization, encryption at rest/in transit, key management, access logging, change control, incident response playbook.

High-level status summary:
- Completed: architecture diagram, KMS configuration screenshots, IAM role bindings export, encryption-at-rest verification, initial access log export (sample day).
- In-progress: SOC2 mapping spreadsheet (final review), private deployment HSM attestation (waiting vendor MOU), automated evidence bundling script.
- Outstanding questions: customer asks for quarterly penetration test plan and proof of past PTs (we have a summary but not the full report for demo).

Contacts:
- Customer lead: Claire Beaumont (Mariner Merchant) — claire.beaumont@mariner.com
- Redwood SE: Priya Nair — priya@redwood.ai
- Evidence owner (this doc): Sofia Alvarez — sofiA@redwood.ai

Evidence index (control mapping, short form):
1) Authentication / Access control (SOC2 CC4 / IAM)
   - Artifact: IAM roles export (infra-config repo) — GitHub PR #289 includes the terraform plan showing role scoping. (linked_artifacts contains PR).
   - Artifact: RBAC matrix (sheet): redwood-internal/pooled-access-roles-2025-10.csv (attached in drive).
   - Notes: demo accounts created with least privilege; service accounts use short-lived tokens via STS.

2) Encryption in transit (TLS)
   - Artifact: sample tcpdump TLS handshake verification (redacted) and load balancer TLS config screenshot (elb-logs/2025-11-01).
   - Notes: TLS 1.2+ enforced, customer cipher suite alignment confirmed with Mariner security.

3) Encryption at rest & KMS (customer demanded key separation)
   - Artifact: KMS key policy screenshots (aws-kms-console-redwood-prod) and KMS audit events export (CloudTrail sample day).
   - Artifact: HSM attestation request doc (vendor MOU pending).
   - Notes: For Dedicated and Private we demonstrated ability to bring-your-own-key (BYOK) via AWS KMS and optional external HSM integration.

4) Audit logging & monitoring
   - Artifact: sample application access logs (2025-11-10 sample, redacted), SSO audit stream export, Console access trail.
   - Artifact: Observability dashboard snapshots (console/rollouts/per-route/latency/2025-11-09.png).
   - Notes: Logs retained according to demo retention policy (90 days); customer requested 365-day retention options — ops doc referenced in linked_artifacts.

5) Change control & deployment provenance
   - Artifact: release-engineering runbook excerpt (release-v2.1), Git commit SHAs for demo deployment, Jenkins/CD pipeline audit log.
   - Notes: All demo deployments were created from tagged releases; can provide full commit history on request under NDA.

6) Network segmentation & Private deployment design
   - Artifact: VPC architecture diagram (private-deployments/test-vpc-01-diagram.png).
   - Artifact: VPN and peering config snippets (redacted).
   - Notes: Private deployment used customer CIDR block, optional egress restrictions applied.

7) Incident response & playbook
   - Artifact: incident-response-playbook-v1.3 (pdf) and sample incident timeline used in tabletop on 2025-11-20.
   - Notes: Playbook includes escalation path and RTO targets; customer requested a shorter SLA summary for contract inclusion.

8) Penetration testing / vulnerability management
   - Artifact: monthly vulnerability dashboard export and remediation log (sheet).
   - Notes: Full pentest reports are vendor-confidential; we provided an executive summary of findings from last two engagements. Customer asked for SOC2 penetration testing cadence doc (action: attach SOC2 audit schedule).

Quick evidence checklist (for this POC handoff):
- [x] Architecture diagram (public and private)
- [x] IAM role export + RBAC matrix
- [x] TLS and ingress config screenshots
- [x] KMS key policy screenshots
- [x] Sample access logs (redacted)
- [x] Release runbook excerpt
- [ ] HSM attestation (pending vendor MOU)
- [ ] Full pentest report (NDA required)
- [ ] 365-day log retention proof (ops policy update pending)

Workshop notes (customer security workshop, 2025-11-18):
- Attendees: Claire B. (Mariner), Priya (SE), Ethan (Infra), Sofia (Security), Miles (SRE).
- Agenda: data flows, key separation options, canary rollback policies, incident notif cadence.
- Key outcomes: agreed on BYOK for Dedicated; Mariner will request HSM attestation if they move to production. They want a follow-up tabletop for incident response with their CC team.
- Action items: create abbreviated SLA appendix (assigned Ethan), produce HSM MOU template (assigned Sofia), finalize SOC2 mapping spreadsheet (assigned Priya).

Notes-to-self / SE tips captured during POC (rough):
- For demos, ensure sample logs are redacted for IP and email fields prior to sharing — small script in infra/ops/redact_logs.py works but needs packaging.
- Keep a trimmed evidence bundle (<=10 files) for initial review to avoid overwhelming customer legal. Full bundle can be delivered under NDA.
- If customer pushes for quarterly pentests in contract, coordinate with Partnerships for vendor scoping — we have two approved vendors on file.

Attachment list (drive file names, approximate):
- mariner-arch-public-private-2025-11-10.png
- kms-policy-screenshots-2025-11-09.pdf
- iam-roles-export-2025-11-08.csv
- access-logs-redacted-2025-11-10.json
- incident-playbook-v1.3.pdf
- vulnerability-remediation-log-2025-10.csv

Privacy / redaction checklist (to pass law/legal review):
- Remove full email addresses from logs (mask to first initial + domain).
- Strip any customer PII beyond masked payment last4.
- Ensure any attached screenshots have account IDs redacted.

Next steps and recommendations:
1) Finalize SOC2 control mapping and attach to this doc (deadline: 2025-12-06) — owner: Priya.
2) Produce HSM MOU template and get vendor signature (target: 2025-12-15) — owner: Sofia.
3) Create a condensed evidence packet (<=10 items) for initial Mariner legal review, and prepare NDA template for full packet delivery — owner: Ethan.
4) Schedule follow-up incident tabletop with Mariner CC by end of Q1 2026 — owner: Miles.

Revision history:
- 2025-11-12: initial seed document created for SE prep (Sofia).
- 2025-11-18: workshop notes added, preliminary artifacts attached (Priya).
- 2025-11-20: incident tabletop sample timeline appended (Miles).
- 2025-12-02: SOC2 mapping draft added, HSM MOU request recorded (Sofia).

Open questions for legal/compliance team:
- Can we supply a sanitized pentest executive summary without NDA? (legal)
- What is the standard wording for BYOK in our commercial agreements? (contracts)

If you are reviewing this packet: please add any missing artifact filenames into the Attachments list above, and flag any items you believe must be redacted further before sending to Mariner.

-- end of logbook --
